title.en: Memories of Peking: South Side Stories

review.en: Written in Taiwan, these linked stories return to a courtyard in southern Beijing in the 1920s, seen through the eyes of a small girl, Yingzi. Each chapter centres on someone she meets and then loses. Lin Haiyin's style is simple and gentle; the book is slight, but its quiet theme of farewell has made it a lasting favourite.
review.zh: 林海音在台湾回望二十年代北京城南的一座院子，透过小女孩英子的眼睛来写。每一篇围绕她遇见、又失去的一个人。文字朴素温和，篇幅单薄，但“离别”这个淡淡的主题，让它成了经久不衰的心爱之书。
